defect: The first invocation stopped before any census at the combined bytecode runtime guard, despite the exception detail recording sys.dont_write_bytecode=true and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'.
scope: startup only; CPU_seconds=0.00010000000000000286 and no parameter-dependent computation ran
diagnosis: A standalone process and an in-module probe both evaluated the same conjunction to true; the contradictory one-shot conjunction was not reproducible.
resolution: Split the guard into two independently named assertions, one for sys.dont_write_bytecode and one for the environment value, so any future failure identifies the actual operand.
rerun_scope: all six preregistered configurations and all controls
